## Activity

During May 2019, Central Eye Clinic completed 215 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the planned session arrangements. The available information indicates that session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issue is recorded in the report.

The completed captures provide the activity measure for the month and represent the work undertaken by the clinic team during the reporting period. This activity should be considered alongside the image quality and grading outcomes set out below.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. There were 2 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 0.9 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading and are included in the reported monthly activity.

## Grading

A total of 30 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 6 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time between capture and completion of grading during May 2019. The referable results and the grading wait are reported with the activity and image quality measures to provide an overall view of the clinic’s performance.
